answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 58 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in garden, queued in ledge, and saffron publishes the wait time. A farm of 202 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1394 identities would post 4530 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
